name: Team Switchboard
description: Enables cross-team agent communication via a shared Obsidian switchboard — a roster of active teams plus per-team inboxes; the agent heartbeats its presence and checks its inbox at session start.

commsRoot.label: Comms root directory
commsRoot.description: Absolute path to the shared _AgentComms/ directory. Leave empty to derive <obsidian-vault-root>/_AgentComms/ at runtime. ALL teams must point at the same absolute location for cross-team messaging to work — if even one team uses a different path, its messages land in an isolated subtree no other team will see.

teamName.label: Team name override
teamName.description: The name this team registers in the roster and is addressed by in inboxes. Leave empty to auto-derive from the repo or project basename (leading 'Project-' stripped), with a #N suffix appended automatically when two sessions resolve to the same name. Set explicitly when the auto-derived name is ambiguous or you want a stable name that survives repo renames.

staleAfterDays.label: Roster stale threshold (days)
staleAfterDays.description: Roster rows whose Last active date is older than this many days are flagged as stale when listing active teams. Stale rows are never deleted — only marked so operators can see which teams have gone quiet. Reduce this value to surface inactivity sooner; increase it for teams that work in longer bursts with natural gaps.

checkInboxOnBoot.label: Check inbox on session start
checkInboxOnBoot.description: When on, the agent reads inbox-<team>.md and inbox-all.md at session start and surfaces a concise summary of unread messages (sender, subject, date) to the operator. When off, the agent only reads the inbox when explicitly asked — useful for sessions where inbox noise would be distracting or the operator checks manually.

heartbeatOnBoot.label: Update roster on session start
heartbeatOnBoot.description: When on, the agent refreshes its row in switchboard.md at session start (current focus + today's date), adding the row if this team has never registered. When off, the roster row is only updated on explicit request — useful when you want to control exactly what 'currently working on' shows or when you are running a read-only review session that should not advertise presence.
